name: CZ-D2-9000
description: CZ-D2-9000 was part of the designation of a CZ-series secretary/business communications droid manufactured by Serv-O-Droid, Inc. During the era of the New Republic around 9 ABY, the droid was left deactivated on a table among an inventory of broken down old droid models in a droid repair shop on the pirate-controlled asteroid Port Borgo.
